description: This file defines the MailTransport class, a custom email transport implementation using Symfony's Mailer component, for handling email sending within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MailTransport
classes.description: A custom email transport class extending Symfony's AbstractTransport, supporting SMTP, secure SMTP, and sendmail protocols, with configuration methods for credentials and encryption.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MailTransport with specified scheme, host, and port, configuring the underlying transport accordingly.

methods.name: loadTransport
methods.description: Loads the transport object based on current configuration, creating a DSN object and applying it to the transport.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password for SMTP authentication.

methods.name: setEncryption
methods.description: Configures encryption options; disables peer verification if not using TLS.

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Sends the email message using the configured transport.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transport.
